data.headline: Software Development Engineer in Test II at Medtronic
data.about: I am a Senior SDET and Embedded Systems Specialist with a decade of experience ensuring the safety and reliability of life-critical technology. From Class III medical devices at Medtronic to aerospace systems at ISRO, my focus is on bridging the gap between complex hardware and robust software.My testing philosophy is rooted in a "Verification-First" approach, moving beyond simple bug-finding to architecting resilient, automated frameworks. I specialize in a broad spectrum of verification methodologies:🧪 Comprehensive Testing Expertise:HIL/SIL Automation: Designing Hardware-in-the-Loop and Software-in-the-Loop frameworks to simulate real-world environments and reduce physical hardware dependency.Sub-System Integration (SSI): Verifying complex interactions between firmware, SoC architectures, and mobile applications.Reliability & Stress Testing: Executed high-load boundary analysis to uncover latent race conditions and memory leaks.White-Box & Black-Box: Deep-dive failure analysis using parsed logs and RTL debugging to perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA).Regression & Smoke Testing: Optimizing CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitLab) to deliver rapid build validations without compromising safety coverage.🛠 Technical Core: Python, C, Embedded Firmware, FPGA (Verilog/VHDL), SoC Architecture (Zynq), and PTC Integrity.🩺 Domain Expertise: Medical Device Verification (FDA/ISO standards), Aerospace protocols, and Agile/Scrum leadership.I am looking to connect with innovative teams in the MedTech, Robotics, or Embedded Systems space.

subComponents.title: Software Development Engineer in Test II
subComponents.caption: Dec 2024 - Present · 1 yr 1 mo

description.text:
•	Optimized Testing Lifecycles: Redesigned the test scope for multiple Insulin pump systems, significantly reducing execution time for smoke and sub-system integration (SSI) phases while maintaining 100% safety coverage.
•	SIL / HIL  Automation & Stability: Improved automation reliability by debugging Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) / Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) regression failures and implementing stability checks to reduce "flaky" test results.
•	 Strategic Triage: Established a "Verification-First" workflow, utilizing parsed logs to isolate issues between pump firmware and mobile application, reducing developer triage time by approximately 30%.
•	 Hardware Readiness: Conducted Pre-Design verification and validation hardware testing for the Insulin pump systems, identifying critical firmware defects during the initial design phase.
•	 Firmware Readiness Protocol: Managed foundational smoke testing protocols for the insulin pump system and documented formal test cases within PTC Integrity (Windchill) for version control and execution tracking. Completing build validations within hours to support rapid Agile/Scrum sprints.
•	 Stress & Boundary Analysis: Executed high-load stress testing on control boards, uncovering latent firmware race conditions and memory leaks under extreme operational scenarios

description.text: Associated with California State University, Northridge

Developed FCS Algorithm with error control mechanism by generating three different programs of generator, verifier and alter on Zynq-7000 SoC. Generator generates FCS bit from message bits, alter alters the transmitted bit with specific error pattern and verifier verifies it at receiver side.

Designed and tested a Parallel Transposed FIR filter of order N = 20 with sampling rate 400Msps using features such as DSP48 for area efficiency. Design is implemented on Zynq SoC using Vivado and MATLAB in Verilog HDL
